assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape illustration for a mobile casual puzzle game's seven-day attendance reward event. Reference image is the game's original mascot Lumi: preserve the orange red-panda face, cream ears, expressive amber eyes, teal gardener overalls and coral scarf. Create a polished dimensional illustrated scene, landscape 3:2 composition. Lumi at the RIGHT third happily presents a chunky coral-and-gold desk calendar with seven blank round day stamps and a gift tied in a coral bow, on a sunlit greenhouse potting table. A small gold coin with a leaf emblem and a red gardening mallet beside the gift. At the LEFT third leave a quiet warm peach wall with subtle soft light for a short live UI title. Soft rounded game-prop materials, tactile depth, appealing light and shadow, restrained highlights, rich coral, apricot, warm gold and sky blue, lush foliage only at corners. NO letters, numbers, text, logos, typography or watermark. No UI buttons, no outer decorative frame. Entire image opaque. This is finished in-game artwork, not a mockup screenshot.
